policy.placement: after authenticated identity and quotas, before costly tool work
policy.bypass: only server-verified entitlement with independent quota; never a client trust header

modeled_client.basis: buyer-declared hashes/second; independent uniform hash model

measured_local.scope: hash microbenchmark only; excludes network, HMAC, body hashing and replay database

acceptance_checks: Measure full verify p95 including shared replay storage
Measure supported clients and respect their solve budgets
Confirm legitimate completion and latency under controlled load
Confirm invalid, expired, cross-request and replay proofs never reach expensive work
Verify edge connection, body, issuance and rate limits
Measure net backend work avoided before claiming savings
report.claim_boundary: A policy rehearsal and local SHA-256 microbenchmark, not deployed protection, an energy measurement, an audit, or an availability guarantee. Client timings are modeled from buyer-supplied throughput; SHA-256 permits hardware acceleration.
